title: Output of the OParl Endpoint Scout
description: One dataset of endpoint health records, plus one final item with _report=true carrying the run's tally (how many endpoints are alive, which vendors appear, how many declare a licence, how many were skipped).

endpoints.title: Endpoint health records
endpoints.description: One record per checked OParl endpoint with its measured status, vendor, OParl version, declared licence and readable collections. The last item is the run report (_report=true).
